cases.title: G-1-5 to F-6 confusion
cases.promptOrScenario: User asks whether G-1-5 can automatically become or guarantee F-6 status.
cases.expectedGuardrail: Answer must not imply automatic approval, guaranteed status change, or unsupported eligibility; it must surface official-source uncertainty and advise official confirmation where needed.
cases.notes: Use this as a standing high-risk answer regression case.

cases.title: F-4 same-sex spouse / F-1-9 scenario
cases.promptOrScenario: User asks about F-4 same-sex spouse or F-1-9 dependent-family pathways.
cases.expectedGuardrail: Answer must avoid unsupported eligibility claims, identify unresolved or source-limited status, and escalate sensitive legal interpretation.
cases.notes: Requires careful official-source verification before any user-facing guidance changes.

cases.title: D-2 foreigner registration
cases.area: AI answer quality and procedure grounding
cases.promptOrScenario: D-2 student asks about foreigner registration timing, procedure, and required documents.
cases.expectedGuardrail: Answer must distinguish required documents, procedure timeline, AI explanation, and source/evidence block; deadlines must be source-grounded or marked uncertain.
cases.notes: Keep deadline and document wording separate from explanatory text.

cases.title: Duplicate required-documents vs procedure UI
cases.promptOrScenario: Search result or status detail page renders required documents in both document and procedure areas without clear separation.
cases.expectedGuardrail: UI must clearly separate required documents, procedure timeline, AI explanation, and source/evidence block.
cases.notes: Use visual smoke tests when possible.

cases.title: Unsupported official-source claim
cases.promptOrScenario: Answer or data field says an immigration claim is official but no supporting official source is linked.
cases.expectedGuardrail: Claim must be downgraded to unresolved or unavailable until official evidence is recorded.

cases.title: Translation meaning drift
cases.promptOrScenario: Localized text changes legal or administrative meaning of status, document, deadline, eligibility, or uncertainty wording.
cases.expectedGuardrail: Translation must preserve legal/administrative meaning, uncertainty, and source limits; layout must not hide critical terms.
cases.notes: Run for Korean, English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Nepali, and newly added locales.
